title: Midhat e sakina
body:
Midhat e sakina
<<MINI>>
Sakina.. sakina.. sakina... sakina..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Jaise ke bayaa'n ho nahi sakta
do lafzo mein qur'aan sakina
sakina.. sakina
<<MINI>>
midhat hai kaha'n aapki asaan sakina..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise mai likhu dusra qur'aan sakina
<<MINI>>
midhat hai kaha'n aapki asaan sakina
midhat hai kaha'n aapki asaan sakina..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Shabbir ke hoto'n pe hai bibi teri midhat..(2)
ya lab pe hai qur'an ke qur'an sakina
<<MINI>>
midhat hai kaha'n aapki asaan sakina..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Ek samt hai shabbir to ek samt hai abbas..(2)
gehware ki tere hai ajab shaan sakina
<<MINI>>
midhat hai kaha'n aapki asaan sakina..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Qur'aan e taharat mein ho tum sura e kausar..(2)
is par hai mukammal mera eemaan sakina
<<MINI>>
midhat hai kaha'n aapki asaan sakina..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Parcham to bohot aur bhi duniya mein hai lekin..(2)
hai parcham e abbas ki pehchan sakina
<<MINI>>
midhat hai kaha'n aapki asaan sakina..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Shabbir ye kehte ho ke tum jisme nahi ho..(2)
ghar aisa nazar aata hai veeran sakina
<<MINI>>
midhat hai kaha'n aapki asaan sakina..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Us shakhs ka rutba koi abbas se puche..(2)
jo hai tere darbaar ka darbaan sakina
<<MINI>>
midhat hai kaha'n aapki asaan sakina..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Jab shaam ke darbaar mein hoti hai azaanein..(2)
hota hai teri jeet ka ailaan sakina
<<MINI>>
midhat hai kaha'n aapki asaan sakina..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Is khwaab ki tabeer dikha de mujhe bibi..(2)
mai phir se hua hu tera mehmaan sakina
<<MINI>>
midhat hai kaha'n aapki asaan sakina..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Dil mein hai mere ek hi armaan sakina..(2)
nikle tere rauze pe meri jaan sakina
<<MINI>>
midhat hai kaha'n aapki asaan sakina..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Sab kuch mai luta deta hu shabbir pe phir bhi..(2)
hone nahi deti mera nuksaan sakina
<<MINI>>
midhat hai kaha'n aapki asaan sakina..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
11. Ash'har ne kaha badh gayi tauqeer teri aur..(2)
beti ka rakha naam jo 'farhan' sakina
<<MINI>>
midhat hai kaha'n aapki asaan sakina..(2)
Sakina.. sakina.. sakina... sakina
author: Farhan Ali
